BEAT 10 — THE TRAINING GROUND CHALLENGE

Society Wives · Shreya EP03 · 1 January 2026 · 3:40–4:05 PM

Police Station Training Ground

3:40 PM

Changing room se nikalte waqt Shreya ne apni khaki uniform locker mein chhod di thi. Navy dry-fit T-shirt, black training trousers aur bandhi hui high ponytail mein woh seedha ground par aayi. Meera cobalt-blue sports tee aur black leggings mein cones ke paas stretch kar rahi thi. Kavita ne burgundy athletic polo ki sleeves set ki, charcoal joggers ke cuffs check kiye aur flag rack se do tags uthaye.

Rohas ne chalk line ki taraf ungli ki. “Ma'am, aaj sirf running hai ya pakadna bhi allowed hai?”

Shreya ne timer uthaya. “Flag control hai. Block, recover, turn—sab count hoga. Bas saamne wale ka move samajhna. Ready?”

Lokesh ne bina kuch kahe markers ki spacing dobara check ki. Meera aur Kavita opposite lanes par aa gayin.

3:43 PM — FIRST RUN

Meera left cone par low bend lekar aage badhi. Usne right foot plant kiya aur achanak angle badla; cobalt-blue tee ka hem kamar ke paas fold hua, leggings ki side seam turn ke saath tan kar phir seedhi ho gayi.

Rohas uska raasta cut karne aa raha tha. Dono ke shoulders takraye. Meera ne uske blocking arm ke neeche se nikalne ki koshish ki, toh forearm uski training shirt ke upper-torso side ko ek pal press karke hata. Uska pichhla shoe tape par fisla.

Meera ka weight saamne gira. Rohas ne turant apna foot piche plant karke uski clothed side-waist par firm hold liya. Balance sambhalte hue uski ungliyan aadhe second ke liye waistband ke kinare ke just andar aayin, phir turant hat gayin. Meera ne uski forearm pakdi, hips wapas centre mein laaye aur seedhi hote hi grip chhuda li. Poora movement ek hi failed cut aur recovery mein hua; na woh giri, na kisi ne drill roki.

“Rohas, marker udhar hai!” Meera ne saans sambhalte hue kaha. “Pakadne mein itni speed hai toh flag bhi pakad lo.”

“Flag bhi le lunga,” Rohas ne jawab diya, par Meera tab tak doosre cone par thi.

Agle marker tak pahunchkar Meera ne folded tee hem neeche kiya. Waist par us firm grip ka pressure ab register hua; uski saans abhi tez thi, lekin chehre par smile aa gayi. Rohas ne apna shoulder roll kiya. Takraav uski expectation se zyada solid tha. Dono ki nazar ek second ko mili—phir whistle baj gayi.

3:45 PM — SIDE FLAG

Kavita ne Lokesh ko left ka fake step diya aur tag ki taraf neeche jhuki. Burgundy polo ka front movement ke saath pull hua; side par ek fold pad gaya. Lokesh uske approach angle par already khada tha.

Dono ek hi narrow lane mein ghuse. Upper arms aur sides bhide. Lokesh ka forearm Kavita ki polo ke upper-torso side se briefly laga jab usne flag tak ka rasta block kiya. Kavita ne uska arm seedha push karne ke bajaye apna stance neeche kiya. Uska right foot chalk ki dhool mein slide hua.

Lokesh ne uski clothed outer hip par palm jama kar dono ko stand se takrane se roka. Dono off-balance the, toh uska support ek pal ke liye joggers ke upar se clothed buttock ke upper outer curve tak aaya, phir turant chhoot gaya. Kavita ne uski forearm par apna weight rakha, ek foot ghumaya, balance wapas liya aur usi opening se nikal gayi.

“Sirf rasta rokhoge ya mujhe rok bhi paoge?” usne palatkar kaha.

Lokesh ki nazar ab bhi flag par thi. “Rasta chhodogi toh pata chalega.”

Kavita hansi nahi; bas uski eyebrow ek pal ko uthi. Do strides baad usne polo ka side fold seedha kiya. Hip par firm support ka ehsaas ab yaad aaya—unexpected tha, par fall se bachane ke liye zaroori. Lokesh ne apna foot position reset kiya. Kavita ka recovery turn usne underestimate kiya tha.

3:47 PM — KAVITA TAKES THE FLAG

Meera ne doosri side se straight sprint ka impression diya. Rohas uski left movement par jaldi mud gaya. Meera ne uske planted foot ke saamne se sharp right cut liya, aur woh ek beat late reh gaya.

Kavita ko gap mil gaya. Woh side marker ke beech se nikli aur flag kheench liya.

“Ma'am, isi liye toh iska reaction time slow hai!” Meera ne kaha.

Kavita ne flag upar uthaya. “Rohas, zyada confidence kabhi-kabhi mehenga padta hai.”

Rohas ne haath failaye. “Theek hai. Pehla round tumhara.”

Shreya ne timer mark kiya. “Win Kavita ki. Reset.”

3:50 PM — SECOND ROTATION

Meera ab Lokesh ke opposite thi. Dono ek hi tag-lane mein saath pahunche. Lokesh ne shoulder set kiya; Meera uske paas se cut karne lagi. Unke shoulders takraye, aur Meera ka shoe loose dirt mein half-turn par skid hua.

Meera ne Lokesh ki sleeve pakdi. Lokesh ne elbow aur clothed side par strong support diya, apna stance neeche karke momentum absorb kiya. Meera ne uski forearm ke against pressure diya, knees bend kiye aur jaise hi balance mila, free hand se tag ko touch karke doosri direction nikal gayi.

“Aap har exit band kar dete ho?” Meera ne chalte-chalte poocha.

“Tum har closed exit dhoondh leti ho,” Lokesh ne kaha.

Is baar Meera ko uski almost-smile dikhi.

Agla cone cross karne par usne apni breathing slow ki. Shoulder impact ki halka sa ache ab notice hui; woh neck ghumate hue chali. Lokesh ne apni elbow flex ki. Usne use girne se roka tha, lekin uske low recovery turn ne uska planned tag miss kara diya. Dono ke liye contact se zyada uska result yaad reh gaya.

3:53 PM — KAVITA AND ROHAS

Kavita ne Rohas ki guard ko test kiya. Pehla arm-block usne duck karke avoid kiya. Rohas side se phir aaya; is baar upper bodies aur shoulders ek solid collision mein mile. Defensive forearm uski polo ke upper-torso side se laga. Kavita ne uski forearm ko apni dono baahon se trap kiya aur neeche stance bana liya.

Rohas ne counter-turn liya. Usne Kavita ke upper arm aur clothed side par hold lekar momentum roka. Kavita ne side step badhaya toh uska foot cone se brush hua. Knee ek pal ke liye fold hua, aur Rohas ne uski clothed outer thigh par firm support dekar poori fall rok di.

Kavita ne pair zameen par jamaya, uski wrist se apna hold break kiya aur lane se nikal gayi. Woh dono ke beech ek hi contested block tha—na ek alag fall, na alag pause.

“Ab toh flag bachaya?” Rohas ne heavy breathing mein poocha.

“Flag bachaya hai,” Kavita ne peeche dekhe bina kaha, “main toh nikal gayi.”

Rohas ne apni forearm rub ki. Kavita ka trap usne jitna socha tha usse zyada strong nikla. Kavita ne doosre marker par pahunchkar joggers ki side seam set ki. Outer thigh par support ka pressure ab mehsoos hua; usne ek second ke liye leg flex ki, phir seedhi khadi ho gayi. Rohas uski taraf dekh raha tha, par next call par dono ne turant apni lanes sambhal li.

3:56 PM — QUICK RESET

Rohas ab Meera ke against zyada alert tha. Usne pehle wali waist recovery repeat karne ki jagah shoulder-line par block rakha. Meera ne uske forearm ko parry kiya aur low turn ke saath passing tag le gayi. Doosri taraf Kavita ne Lokesh ko false low reach dikhayi. Lokesh ne stance badla; Kavita ne uski sleeve se apna arm free karke short cut complete kar diya.

“Ab seekh rahe ho,” Shreya ne timer se nazar uthaye bina kaha.

Meera hansi. “Ma'am, inko thoda aur time chahiye.”

“Time khatam nahi hua,” Rohas bola. “Aap khud ek round khelkar dikhao.”

3:58 PM — SHREYA'S CHALLENGE

Shreya ne timer reset kiya. Meera aur Kavita side markers par spotters ban gayin. Shreya running line par aayi, navy tee ki sleeves movement ke saath set hui. Uska weight feet par balanced tha; nazar seedhi flag par.

Rohas ne pehla route block kiya. Shreya ne uska planted foot padha, right se sharp cut liya aur use do steps peeche chhod diya.

“Rohas, nazar flag pe rakho. Ya attention kahin aur hai?” usne mudte hue kaha.

Rohas jawab banata reh gaya. Lokesh ne kuch nahi kaha. Woh Shreya ka pehla feint nahi, second pivot dekh raha tha.

Shreya flag ki taraf mudhi toh Lokesh apna outside foot pehle hi plant kar chuka tha. Narrow tag-lane mein dono ek saath aaye. Unki forearms takrayin; Shreya ne momentum sambhalne ko uske forearm par brief pressure diya. Lokesh ka haath clothed waist ke paas lage side training-tag tak gaya. Shoes chalk line par ghise. Shreya balance mein rahi—lekin Lokesh tag nikaal chuka tha.

“Ma'am, aapka second move predict ho gaya,” Lokesh ne seedha kaha.

Shreya ne uske haath ka tag dekha. Ek beat ke liye woh genuinely surprised thi, phir uski usual competitive expression laut aayi.

“Ek round jeetne se mujhe predict karna nahi seekh gaye tum.”

“Toh ek aur chance dijiye.”

“Next round.”

Meera ne short whistle maari. Kavita scoreboard ki taraf hansi. Rohas ne Lokesh ki foot placement dekhi; ab use samajh aaya ki woh first move par react kar raha tha, jabki Lokesh second move ke liye pehle se ready tha.

4:05 PM — WRAP

Shreya ne timer band kiya. “Bas. Flags aur tags rack mein. Recovery bhi training ka part hai.”

Meera ne paani peete hue shoulder stretch ki. Kavita ne forearm rotate ki aur joggers ki dusty seam brush ki. Rohas apna shoulder relax kar raha tha; Lokesh chalk se lagi palms saaf kar raha tha.

“Kal cones seedhe rakhna,” Meera ne Rohas ko kaha.

“Cones seedhe the,” Kavita ne flag rakhte hue jawab diya. “Defenders slow the.”

Shreya ne score sheet par Kavita ki first-round win aur Lokesh ka decisive tag mark kiya. “Dismissed.”

Ground se sab apne changing rooms ki taraf chale gaye. Thodi der baad navy, cobalt-blue aur burgundy training wear ki jagah duty uniforms thi. Shreya ne properly buttoned khaki shirt ke saath file uthayi aur station closeout ke liye nikal gayi.
